verdict.rationale: Archived docs describe a Smithery REST interface, but the vendor's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, API keys, and SDKs stopped working on 2026-10-31 and the docs tree was removed. The surviving registry.smithery.ai JSON endpoint is undocumented, with no docs or OpenAPI spec. The maintained CLI is a different surface from a public API, so no documented public API currently exists to drive the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
